narr: An isolated instance of flooding occurred due to heavy rainfall.
ev: A rapid rise along the northern branch of the Anacostia River caused the water to rise above flood stage, cresting at 9.31 feet at 1:00 AM EST. Backyards of homes on Kemps Mill Road just south of Randolph Road were flooded.
lsr: BROAD BRANCH ROAD NW CLOSED BOTH WAYS BETWEEN BRANDYWINE STREET NW & BEACH DRIVE NW DUE TO FLASH FLOODING.
RAPID RISE OF NORTHERN BRANCH OF THE ANACOSTIA RIVER TO ABOVE MINOR BETWEEN 145-230 AM. MAXIMUM LEVEL REACHED 9.31' (MINOR: 9.00').
